icon-card-carousel.looks: A section title and subtitle above a sliding row of light cards, each with an optional icon, a title, a short line and a button. Cards without icons are shorter. Thinner styles make narrower, taller cards.
icon-card-carousel.use: A browsable set of related items (publications, programmes) with a button each, more than fit across the page.
icon-card-carousel.avoid: Three or fewer items: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid, which shows them all at once.

fields.heading: The section title.
fields.subtitle: One sentence under the title.
fields.styleVariant: default; thinner: narrower, taller cards; thinner-dynamic: the same with the content centred in each card.
fields.blockBackgroundColor: Optional band colour behind the whole carousel.

fields.icon: Optional line icon at the top of the card. Give every card one or none.
fields.heading: The card title, a few words.
